name: Eshtemoa
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Eshtemoa is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of the tribe of Judah. He is the son of Ishba and belongs to the lineage of Caleb. The name Eshtemoa is also associated with a city in the hill country of Judah that was given to the Levites.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Eshtemoa is listed as the son of Ishba in the genealogy of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Described as a Maacathite
keyEvents.description: Eshtemoa is called the Maacathite, which may indicate an association with the people or region of Maakah.

keyEvents.title: The city of Eshtemoa given to the Levites
keyEvents.description: The city of Eshtemoa in the hill country of Judah was given to the descendants of Aaron as a Levitical city.

keyEvents.title: Eshtemoa among the cities of Judah
keyEvents.description: Eshtemoa is mentioned as one of the cities in the inheritance of the tribe of Judah, located in the hill country.

keyEvents.title: David Sends Spoils of War to Eshtemoa
keyEvents.description: After the victory over the Amalekites, David sent part of the spoils of war to the elders in Eshtemoa, who were among his friends.
